test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Fitter) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following columns.

 
 

 **Column I**
 **Column II**
 
 

 Hinge (A)
 Reinforcing the downward projecting sand mass (P)
 
 

 Welding (B)
 Finishing flat surfaces and joints (Q)
 
 

 Trowels (C)
 Permanent joint (R)
 
 

 Gaggers (D)
 Movable joint (S)
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Correct Matches:**

 
• **Hinge (A) - Movable joint (S):** A hinge is a type of mechanical joint that allows two components to rotate relative to each other, commonly used in doors, gates, and lids. Its defining characteristic is that it provides a movable joint, allowing for smooth and controlled motion.
 
• **Welding (B) - Permanent joint (R):** Welding is a process used to join materials, typically metals or thermoplastics, by causing coalescence. The result is a permanent joint that cannot be easily separated without destroying the material around the weld.
 
• **Trowels (C) - Finishing flat surfaces and joints (Q):** Trowels are hand tools used in construction to apply, spread, shape, or smooth materials like mortar or plaster. Their primary function is to finish flat surfaces and joints, ensuring a smooth and even application.
 
• **Gaggers (D) - Reinforcing the downward projecting sand mass (P):** Gaggers are tools used in foundry work to reinforce the downward projecting sand mass in molds. This prevents the sand from collapsing during the casting process, ensuring the stability and accuracy of the mold.

The correct option is:

**Option 4:** A-S, B-R, C-Q, D-P

This option correctly pairs each item in Column I with its corresponding description in Column II:

 
• Hinge (A) - Movable joint (S)
 
• Welding (B) - Permanent joint (R)
 
• Trowels (C) - Finishing flat surfaces and joints (Q)
 
• Gaggers (D) - Reinforcing the downward projecting sand mass (P)
